title: Bash Scripting Essentials
description: Write robust bash scripts — variables, loops, conditionals, functions, error handling, and common patterns.

entries.label: Strict Mode Header
entries.description: Start every script with this: exit on error (-e), undefined vars (-u), pipe failures (-o pipefail)

entries.label: Variable Assignment
entries.description: Assign and use variables — always quote and use ${} for clarity

entries.label: Command Substitution
entries.description: Capture the output of a command into a variable

entries.label: If/Else Condition
entries.command:
if [[ -f "$FILE" ]]; then
  echo "File exists"
else
  echo "File not found"
fi
entries.description: Conditional check — use [[ ]] for safer string/file tests

entries.label: For Loop
entries.command:
for file in *.json; do
  echo "Processing: ${file}"
done
entries.description: Iterate over files matching a glob pattern

entries.label: While Read Loop
entries.command:
while IFS= read -r line; do
  echo "$line"
done < input.txt
entries.description: Read a file line by line — preserves whitespace and special chars

entries.label: Function with Args
entries.description: Define a function with local variables and positional arguments

entries.label: Trap for Cleanup
entries.description: Run cleanup code when the script exits (even on error or Ctrl+C)

entries.label: Default Value
entries.description: Use a default value if a variable or argument is not set

entries.label: Check Command Exists
entries.command:
if ! command -v docker &>/dev/null; then
  echo "docker not installed"
  exit 1
fi
entries.description: Verify a command is available before using it in a script

entries.label: Array Iteration
entries.command:
TOOLS=("git" "docker" "node")
for tool in "${TOOLS[@]}"; do
  echo "Checking ${tool}"
done
entries.description: Define and loop through an array of values

entries.label: String Contains Check
entries.description: Check if a string contains a substring using glob patterns
